correctness.rationale: The 15-state suffix/parity transducer, reachable-state Moore minimization and finite exhaustive inhomogeneous-path profile BFS reduce every length-three binary predicate to a finite intrinsic-DFAO computation. Applying Allouche–Yao Theorems 1–2 and binary normalization determines each opacity exactly. The complete 256-mask enumeration has classes 249 at 0, four at 1, two at 1/2 and one at 1/4. A direct-digit crosscheck is corroborative, not an infinite proof; injectivity of all 256 sequences follows separately by recovering each mask bit from u(1ab) and u(10ab).

value.rationale: This is a motivated complete and exactly reproducible first multi-pattern case: length-three binary windows have eight independent Boolean choices. It classifies rare nontransparent XOR combinations, including intermediate opacity values, rather than just single patterns, and gives a baseline for studying longer local windows. It makes no claim to a general closed-form classification.
